desc: a shared script battle (hei_03's four Goombas): the guest's link down 8 seconds mid-battle; the host's player plays its units meanwhile, the guest catches up and plays its own again (offscreen: the guest's catch-up runs several frames a picture, which a headless game has no pictures for) (the guest's link goes down at the battle's step 6 for 8 seconds, wherever its frames are; the battle starts once the guest is surely in the room)

log_must: can't be reached: their units are this player's
is back: their units are theirs again
